desc: Ideation / derive correct reduction: answer[i] = max depth of trie node with ≥ k words after removal (NOT depth + kth ending length — that formula was wrong)
Implement trie with cnt per node; record path node ids per word (sum of lengths ≤ 1e5, so fine)
Precompute per-depth qualCount[d], qualNode[d] (id if count==1), and nextQual[d] (largest qualifying depth ≤ d) via backward pass

Per word: candidate A = deepest path node with cnt ≥ k+1; candidate B = scan depths descending using qualCount/qualNode/nextQual, skipping a depth only if its unique qualifying node is exactly the word's path node at that depth
Handle edge cases: n-1 < k → 0; k = 1; duplicate words; words shorter than candidate depth d (path node at depth d doesn't exist → unique node can't be on path)
Verify against both provided examples and randomized brute-force tests; assemble final code in starter format with typing import
